sources.title: CSCEC Fifth Bureau: Shandong University Longshan data-centre and research-platform project begins aboveground structural construction
sources.publisher: 中国建筑第五工程局有限公司 (China Construction Fifth Engineering Bureau)
sources.source_family: 中国建筑第五工程局有限公司 (China Construction Fifth Engineering Bureau)
sources.attribution: 中国建筑第五工程局有限公司; author 范荣美; second review 曾中兴; third review 任靖坤
sources.summary: The contractor reports completion of underground structure and transition to aboveground main-structure construction. The mixed-use building has compute machine rooms and their support spaces in the north and research/office functions in the south. No individual wing completion, data-hall fit-out or operation is claimed.
sources.date_semantics: September 7 is the dated original contractor report confirming current construction. The underground milestone occurred recently, with no exact event date. No groundbreaking, operation or completion day is inferred.
sources.original_title: 山东公司济南山大龙山校区数智平台项目全面开启地上建设新阶段
sources.image_identity_bridge: The article image title gives 山东大学龙山校区(创新港)数智支撑研究平台(一期)项目工程总承包(EPC)效果图. It identifies the full project scope but is explicitly a rendering, not a progress photograph.
sources.project_scope: Physical data-centre/compute-machine-room component within the Phase 1 integrated research building; southern research/office space is distinct and has no capacity assigned to the DC.

sources.title: Named Shandong University Longshan Digital Support Research Platform Phase 1 property, OpenStreetMap way 1551159473
sources.summary: Community-mapped construction-property polygon bears the exact Phase 1 project title. It provides a representative project-property locator only, with no official surveyed boundary or particular machine-room position asserted.
sources.date_semantics: August 20, 2026 is the map edit timestamp, not a physical-status observation. Retrieval does not refresh project status.

sources.title: Jinan official survey tender identifies Shandong University Longshan Digital Support Research Platform Phase 1
sources.publisher: 济南公共资源交易中心 (Jinan Public Resources Trading Center)
sources.source_family: 济南公共资源交易中心 (Jinan Public Resources Trading Center)
sources.attribution: 济南公共资源交易中心 (Jinan Public Resources Trading Center)
sources.summary: The original official survey tender names 山东大学龙山校区（创新港）数智支撑研究平台项目（一期）, construction unit Shandong University and location in Zhangqiu, Jinan, within the Longshan campus. Historical identity context; procurement is not treated as development consent or current physical work.
sources.date_semantics: The displayed publication date is June 30, 2025. The July 1–7 notice interval is separate. Neither is a current construction observation.
sources.area_exclusion: The reported 18,500 square metres describes the mixed-use project; it is not assigned as data-hall area.

sources.title: China Government Procurement: Shandong University Longshan Phase 1 data-centre machine-room and intelligent-systems design tender
sources.publisher: 中国政府采购网 (China Government Procurement Network)
sources.source_family: 中国政府采购网 (China Government Procurement Network)
sources.attribution: 中国政府采购网 (China Government Procurement Network)
sources.summary: The original government procurement notice explicitly procures data-centre machine-room design for the exact Phase 1 project at Longshan campus in Zhangqiu. It jointly names Shandong University and China Construction Fifth Engineering Bureau as tenderers, bridging the official project title to the current contractor report. The separate purchaser contact address on Shanda South Road is not the project site.
sources.date_semantics: February 5, 2026 is the published tender date. The design procurement is historical identity and physical-facility scope evidence, not current physical work or issued development consent.
sources.project_location_as_published: 山东省济南市章丘区山东大学龙山校区（创新港）
sources.excluded_contact_address: 山东省济南市山大南路27号
sources.area_exclusion: The 18,495-square-metre design-scope figure is not selected as data-hall area or capacity; the structure includes southern research/office functions.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap Longshan project context separates Digital Support Research Platform from nearby Digital Innovation Centre
sources.summary: The captured context maps separate named properties: way 1551159473 is the selected Digital Support Research Platform Phase 1; way 1551159472 is the distinct Digital Innovation Centre Phase 1. Neither the neighbour nor a whole-university centroid is selected.
sources.date_semantics: Map capture supplies property context only, not a physical-status date.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap changeset 187763688 provenance for the Longshan project polygon
sources.summary: The project way was added in a community changeset listing Mapbox Satellite imagery. No official planning source, survey accuracy or status observation is provided; this source records provenance limits.
sources.date_semantics: The changeset timestamp is map-edit provenance only, not project status.
